notes_for_human: No verbatim opening/closing dates for the next Rising Fellows cycle were found on any Bridgewater-owned page. The students landing page (known URL) does not mention Rising Fellows at all in its current content, and Bridgewater's own campus-recruiting Greenhouse board (job-boards.greenhouse.io/bridgewatercampusrecruiting) currently lists only two postings — '2027 Investment Associate Intern' and 'Metaculus Resume Drop' — no active Rising Fellows listing as of 2026-07-29. Background on program structure (three-week program for first-year/sophomore students from underrepresented backgrounds, feeding into an Immersion program in sophomore year and internship interviews in junior year) comes from Bridgewater's original 2021 launch announcement (https://www.bridgewater.com/in-the-news/bridgewater-launches-rising-fellows-program-to-help-expand-investment-industry-diversity and the matching PR Newswire release), but that page describes the program generically, not the 2027 cycle, and WebFetch extracted no verbatim eligibility/date/sponsorship sentences from it despite the source being legitimate. One search-engine synthesis claimed application dates of 'December 1, 2025–January 31, 2026' for a sophomore-spring 2027 cycle, but this was the search tool's own generated summary, not a quote traceable to any specific fetched Bridgewater page — per the verbatim-only rule it is EXCLUDED from the structured fields above and flagged here only as an unverified claim requiring independent confirmation. Aggregator/prep sites (getsmartresume.com, wearehbcus.com, startup.jobs) surfaced in search results were deliberately not used as quote sources per instructions. Recommend a human check job-boards.greenhouse.io/bridgewatercampusrecruiting periodically (Rising Fellows postings appear seasonally, not currently live) and/or a JS-capable browser fetch of the 2027 Investment Associate Intern posting to pull its full body text, which a plain WebFetch could not retrieve.
